data.title: Data Engineer
data.description:
Join our data platform group and help build dependable services used throughout the organisation.

What you will do

  • Design and operate batch and streaming pipelines using Python, SQL, and cloud services.
  • Work with analysts and product engineers to improve data quality, observability, and delivery.
  • Review designs and support production systems.

What we are looking for

You have practical experience building production data pipelines, communicating technical trade-offs, and improving systems over time. We welcome applicants with varied industry backgrounds.
